legend: Dad's chest (Mum and Dad's, N): four digits, 2 1 4 5. The booking on the fridge says departure 22:45; Mum's note across it says an hour earlier. Inside: the passports (lift the drawer front, then pull).
The toy oven (Elliot and Zaina's, E): Nana's torch is Zaina's cake. She gives it up for Peanut, who is under the fourth sofa cushion (Elliot saw her with him there).
The yard boxes (yard, W): four drawings; Dad put the present in the one Elliot drew on. Elliot signs with a little cog (the rocket on the fridge and on his pinboard).
Mary's diary (Mary's room, S), the Night Moth: five letters. Nana's postcards (pinboard, dated) matched to Dad's pins (the map, named), in date order: A T T I C.
The front door (dining end, E) opens only when the case is zipped: five things in (passports, torch, present, jumper, toothbrush); the library book bounces out.
The bathroom is a close-up off the corridor's west wall, not a room. Every doorway is open from the start.

A note on the walls: this level was built before the floor-plan rule (playbook 4y), so a room's first view is not always its north wall. Each view is shown on the wall where it stands, and the four still run clockwise.
